purpose: Separate best-found representational capacity from finite-shot trainability for the two 225-coordinate architectures.

seed_policy.description: Equal-coordinate architectures use the same initial parameter vector within each field-restart cell.

objective: exact eta_sum with no measurement sampling
report: best median and worst held-out long-range ZZ error

interpretation.equal_best_values: finite-shot differences primarily indicate trainability or measurement efficiency
interpretation.mera_better_best_value: supports an architecture or inductive-bias advantage within the tested optimization diagnostic
interpretation.mps_better_best_value: rules out a general MERA representational-superiority claim

guardrails: The best of 20 restarts is a best-found value, not a certified global optimum.
Automatic differentiation must accumulate derivatives through every occurrence of a shared MERA parameter.
No finite-shot result or evaluation field is used to initialize these runs.
All 20 restarts are reported; failed or nonconverged starts are retained.
